summary: Enova International filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect wholly-owned subsidiary NetCredit Receivables 2022, LLC entered a Fourth Amendment to its October 21, 2022 Note Issuance and Purchase Agreement with Jefferies Funding LLC as administrative agent and initial note purchaser, Citibank, N.A. as collateral agent and paying agent, and other note purchasers. Terms include a $200 million commitment, SOFR plus 4.00% borrowing rate, 90% funding rate, revolving period termination October 15, 2028, and maturity October 15, 2030. This is a routine secured warehouse credit facility amendment under Items 1.01 and 2.03, not a special situation.
